news.title: Japan Tobacco backs unified vape tax
Japan Tobacco lance en Roumanie de nouveaux sticks nicotinés sans tabac

summary: Japan Tobacco International (JTI) is cigarette manufacturing company, founded in 1985. Type: listed company. About 63,969 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: The international arm of Japan Tobacco, selling cigarettes and other tobacco products outside Japan, with manager-level roles in Amstelveen.

culture.text: Parent Japan Tobacco is a Tokyo-listed cigarette maker with about 63,969 employees.

open.text: The IND register match found is for a different company (Japan Radio Co.), so its sponsor status here is unconfirmed.

growth.text: It launched new tobacco-free nicotine sticks in Romania.

worth_knowing.text: It works in the tobacco industry, which some candidates may want to weigh.
